verification: connected MCP discovery and inspection succeeded; provider execution not performed

query.description: Describe the companies to find, e.g. 'payment infrastructure companies in Ireland'. Up to 500 characters (5000 in ultra mode).

mode.description: 'fast' (the default): 2 credits ($0.004) per page, query up to 500 characters. 'ultra': a deeper search, 10 credits ($0.02) per page, query up to 5000 characters.

countries.description: Headquarters countries as two-letter codes, e.g. ['US', 'GB'].

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous response; send it with the same query and filters to fetch the next page.

notes: Billed per Context.dev credit actually consumed ($0.002 per credit, reported by the vendor on every response); failed and blocked requests consume none. On x402 the quoted estimate is the price.
2 credits per page of results in fast mode ($0.004), the default; 10 in ultra mode ($0.02). A search with no results is free.

query.description: A company name or website. The backend auto-detects the input type. Examples: 'https://canva.com', 'canva'.

company.description: Company website (e.g. 'https://canva.com') or the company uuid returned by the akta Company Search endpoint. A bare company name is NOT accepted here — resolve it via company-search first.

sections.description: Sections to return (comma-separated query param). Required — to get every section, list all of them. Available: firmographic, business_model, company_assessment, trust_signal, company_hierarchy, digital_presence, financial_estimate, location, management_profile, product_offering, strategic_signal, customer_profile, industry, technology, funding_detail, mna_and_investment.

pricing_caveat: akta /v1/company/enrichment catalog base is USD 0.025; detailed inspection lists per-section rates. Firmographic is USD 0.10 and digital_presence is USD 0.025. Reinspect before a budgeted run.
provider_docs_web_status: The three returned doc URLs could not be opened through the web tool.
